name: one-hand
description: A transparent gesture bar across the bottom of the editor, on every tab, for driving the app one-handed on mobile: swipe left / right / up, double tap, or press and hold to run customizable commands (defaults: next tab, previous tab, open quick switcher; both tap gestures start unbound).

oneHand.show.description: When the gesture bar is active at the bottom of the editor.

oneHand.actions.description: Which command each gesture runs, as JSON (edited with the picker below — empty means the defaults: swipe left = next tab, right = previous tab, up = quick switcher, double tap and long press unbound).
